```{=html}
<style>

#result-app {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 1rem 0;
}

.result-card {
  border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  border-radius: .5rem;
  padding: 1.2rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
}

.result-status {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.score-box {
  margin: 1rem 0;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  border-radius: .4rem;
}

.score-value {
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.feedback-box {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: #f7f7f7;
  border-radius: .4rem;
}

.task-card {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1.2rem;
  border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  border-radius: .5rem;
}

.task-card h3 {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.solution-code {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: #f7f7f7;
  border: 1px solid #e1e1e1;
  border-radius: .4rem;
  font-family:
    ui-monospace,
    SFMono-Regular,
    Menlo,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
}

.hidden-summary {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.teacher-comment {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  border-left: 4px solid #777;
  background: #f7f7f7;
}

.pending-note {
  margin-top: .7rem;
}

</style>

<div id="result-app">

  <div id="loading">
    Loading result...
  </div>

  <div
    id="result-content"
    style="display:none;">
  </div>

</div>

<script>

(() => {

  const API_BASE =
    "https://itarch-backend-fpdsf6brfpanf5d8.northeurope-01.azurewebsites.net/api";


  const loading =
    document.getElementById(
      "loading"
    );


  const content =
    document.getElementById(
      "result-content"
    );


  /*
   * Escape values before inserting them
   * into HTML.
   */

  function escapeHtml(value) {

    return String(
      value ?? ""
    )
      .replaceAll(
        "&",
        "&amp;"
      )
      .replaceAll(
        "<",
        "&lt;"
      )
      .replaceAll(
        ">",
        "&gt;"
      )
      .replaceAll(
        '"',
        "&quot;"
      )
      .replaceAll(
        "'",
        "&#039;"
      );
  }


  /*
   * Preserve line breaks in normal text.
   */

  function textWithBreaks(value) {

    return escapeHtml(value)
      .replaceAll(
        "\n",
        "<br>"
      );
  }


  /*
   * Task details shown after preliminary
   * results become available.
   */

  function renderTasks(tasks) {

    if (
      !Array.isArray(tasks) ||
      tasks.length === 0
    ) {
      return "";
    }


    return tasks
      .map(task => {

        const passed =
          task.hidden_tests?.passed;

        const total =
          task.hidden_tests?.total;


        let hiddenHtml = "";


        if (
          Number.isFinite(
            Number(passed)
          ) &&
          Number.isFinite(
            Number(total)
          )
        ) {

          hiddenHtml = `
            <div class="hidden-summary">
              Hidden tests:
              ${escapeHtml(passed)}
              /
              ${escapeHtml(total)}
              passed
            </div>
          `;
        }


        let expectedOutputHtml = "";


        if (task.expected_output) {

          expectedOutputHtml = `
            <p>
              <strong>Expected output:</strong>
              ${textWithBreaks(
                task.expected_output
              )}
            </p>
          `;
        }


        let feedbackHtml = "";


        if (task.automated_feedback) {

          feedbackHtml = `
            <div class="feedback-box">

              <p>
                <strong>
                  Automated feedback
                </strong>
              </p>

              <p>
                ${textWithBreaks(
                  task.automated_feedback
                )}
              </p>

            </div>
          `;
        }


        return `
          <div class="task-card">

            <h3>
              ${escapeHtml(
                task.title ||
                "Task"
              )}
            </h3>

            <p>
              ${textWithBreaks(
                task.text
              )}
            </p>

            ${expectedOutputHtml}

            <p>
              <strong>
                Your solution
              </strong>
            </p>

            <pre class="solution-code">${escapeHtml(
              task.code || ""
            )}</pre>

            ${hiddenHtml}

            ${feedbackHtml}

          </div>
        `;

      })
      .join("");
  }


  /*
   * Pending result.
   */

  function renderPending(data) {

    content.innerHTML = `
      <div class="result-card">

        <div class="result-status">
          Submission received
        </div>

        <p>
          ${escapeHtml(
            data.message ||
            "Your submission has been received."
          )}
        </p>

        <p class="pending-note">
          ${
            escapeHtml(
              data.preliminary_result_message ||
              "Preliminary results are usually available within approximately 15 minutes."
            )
          }
        </p>

        <p class="pending-note">
          ${
            escapeHtml(
              data.final_result_message ||
              "Final results will normally be available within one week after instructor review."
            )
          }
        </p>

      </div>
    `;
  }


  /*
   * Preliminary automated result.
   */

  function renderPreliminary(data) {

    content.innerHTML = `
      <div class="result-card">

        <div class="result-status">
          Preliminary result
        </div>

        <div class="score-box">

          <div>
            Preliminary score
          </div>

          <div class="score-value">
            ${escapeHtml(
              data.preliminary_score
            )}
            /
            ${escapeHtml(
              data.max_score
            )}
          </div>

        </div>

        <p>
          This is an automated preliminary result.
          The instructor may change the final score
          after reviewing your submission.
        </p>

      </div>

      ${renderTasks(
        data.tasks
      )}
    `;
  }


  /*
   * Final instructor-reviewed result.
   */

  function renderFinal(data) {

    let teacherComment = "";


    if (data.teacher_comment) {

      teacherComment = `
        <div class="teacher-comment">

          <p>
            <strong>
              Teacher comment
            </strong>
          </p>

          <p>
            ${textWithBreaks(
              data.teacher_comment
            )}
          </p>

        </div>
      `;
    }


    


    content.innerHTML = `
      <div class="result-card">

        <div class="result-status">
          Final result
        </div>

        <div class="score-box">

          <div>
            Final score
          </div>

          <div class="score-value">
            ${escapeHtml(
              data.final_score
            )}
            /
            ${escapeHtml(
              data.max_score
            )}
          </div>

        </div>

        ${teacherComment}

        
      </div>

      ${renderTasks(
        data.tasks
      )}
    `;
  }


  /*
   * Load result token from URL.
   */

  async function loadResult() {

    const params =
      new URLSearchParams(
        window.location.search
      );


    const token =
      params.get(
        "token"
      );


    if (!token) {

      loading.textContent =
        "Invalid result link.";

      return;
    }


    try {

      const response =
        await fetch(
          `${API_BASE}/getResult?token=${encodeURIComponent(
            token
          )}`
        );


      let data = {};


      try {

        data =
          await response.json();

      } catch (_) {}


      if (
        !response.ok ||
        data.success === false
      ) {

        throw new Error(
          data.error ||
          "Result could not be loaded."
        );
      }


      loading.style.display =
        "none";


      content.style.display =
        "block";


      if (
        data.result_status ===
        "pending"
      ) {

        renderPending(data);

        return;
      }


      if (
        data.result_status ===
        "preliminary"
      ) {

        renderPreliminary(data);

        return;
      }


      if (
        data.result_status ===
        "final"
      ) {

        renderFinal(data);

        return;
      }


      content.innerHTML = `
        <div class="result-card">
          Unknown result status.
        </div>
      `;


    } catch (err) {

      loading.textContent =
        err.message ||
        "Result could not be loaded.";
    }
  }


  loadResult();

})();

</script>
```
